title: Cantonal Rebellion
summary: The English Wikipedia article "Cantonal Rebellion", at revision 1380209948, opens: "The Cantonal Revolution was an attempt to establish a revolutionary republic, based on a decentralised system of cantons, in Spain in 1873." That is the article's account and not yet this atlas's; nobody has read this record, and review.html is where somebody does. Wikidata item Q3100354, imported by tools/import/wikidata.mjs. The item's own description reads "insurrection in parts of Spain during the First Spanish Republic". Everything here is copied from the item's own fields and nothing in it is this atlas's account of the thing: that is still to be written, and review.html is where somebody writes it.
regionNote: Lane written by the Wikidata import (derived from its own point): this event points at no place record, so the timeline has nothing else to go on.
